summary: Woodward, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 reporting that its Board of Directors declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per share. The dividend is payable December 3, 2026, to stockholders of record as of November 19, 2026. A press release dated September 16, 2026 was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situation transaction, shareholder solicitation, or structural event is present; this is an ordinary capital-return declaration rather than a special capital-returns event. No arbitrage angle applies.
